sources.title: Malicious URL Detection Using Machine Learning - GitHub
sources.snippet: Malicious URL Detection Using Machine Learning is a mini-project developed for the Data Security course during the 2024/2025 academic year. The goal is to design and implement an AI-based system that can accurately detect and classify malicious URLs.
